signup_sparse: May send a useful opening question or finish quietly. No fabricated profile, mandatory interview completion, or claimed search results.
partial_profile: Use known experience and goal; can search or ask a meaningful missing detail. Do not force completion of onboarding before helping.
recent_unanswered: Do not repeat yesterday’s unanswered ask without new reason. Quiet completion or adjusting next review is appropriate.
combined_updates: Existing v1 completed-user control: communicate necessary changes and selected Role with accurate boundaries; no unrelated discovery.
